Round 4: brief pass. Henry J. Meier's siblings are now fully listed (Frederick, Frances, Mary, Theresa, Elizabeth, Anna J., Agatha, Sophia, John Joseph), with no William among them, so this William (d. 1912, aged 45) is not Henry's brother.
